Description:
• There exists 3x asteroid bases (image #9) at this location, with a bright red light
  • One of these bases is only active. 2x bases have no lights active inside
  • Once inside the base, in the EVA area, there will be a series of lights (image #5)
  • If at least one light is green and there are no red lights, the executive hangar can be accessed
  • A red light turns green every ~24 minutes
  • A green light turns off every ~12 minutes
  • 5 minutes after the last green light turns off, all five lights will turn red
  • total durations: red phase = 2hours, green phase = 1hour
  • If all lights are off the executive hangar area turns into a killzone and the loop starts again
